property_summary: After C's SetLogFile has been pointed at a live Log contract, any subsequent Put (of any value, by any caller) must succeed rather than revert; the mutant never stores LogFile, so Put calls AddMessage on the zero address and always reverts.
change_summary: Delete the assignment `LogFile = Log(_log);` so the LogFile address is never set and subsequent Put calls attempt to call a zero-address Log.
